headline: Delta (DAL) Stock Looks Cheap On Earnings But Pricey After 125% Return
summary: Delta Air Lines stock has delivered a strong 124.7% return over the past 5 years, yet today's mixed valuation checks leave investors weighing how much upside is already reflected in the current US$87.44 share price. Over 5 years, a 124.7% total return suggests the market has already reassessed Delta Air Lines more positively and may now be more sensitive to changes in expectations.
